summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of Riffeltippen. Backend: 29 pytest cases (auth, duels CRUD, tips, results/points, leaderboard, edge cases) - 27 passed. Frontend: all 12 requested flows verified end-to-end on the public preview URL (register->auto-login, login/logout, admin nav+panel, create duel appears on home, tip 1/U/2 with count increment + my-pick indicator, change tip, anonymous tip -> /login redirect, admin result registration -> duell moves to Resultater and off open list, +3 points reflected in points pill/Mine Tips 'Riktig +3'/leaderboard, leaderboard ranking with correct/accuracy, admin delete duel). No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: Malformed duel id returns 500 Internal Server Error (bson.errors.InvalidId raised by ObjectId(duel_id) - see backend.err.log). Should return 400/404. Suggest a helper that validates ObjectId.is_valid() before querying.
No brute-force protection/lockout: 6 consecutive wrong passwords all returned 401 (no 429, no account lock). Playbook expects lockout after 5 failed attempts.

Auth uses Bearer token in localStorage, not httpOnly cookies (get_current_user does read an access_token cookie but login/register never Set-Cookie). Playbook item 'httpOnly cookies on login' not met - flag only, since Bearer-in-localStorage was the stated design. Token TTL 7 days, no refresh/revocation.
N+1 queries: 2 count_documents per user inside a loop; will not scale. Consider an aggregation pipeline.

ui_bugs.issue: No auth guard and no .catch on api.get('/my-tips'). Anonymous direct navigation leaves the page stuck on 'Laster...' forever and throws an unhandled promise rejection (401) in console. Add a redirect to /login and error state.
Unknown routes (e.g. /tullball) render only the navbar - no 404 page or catch-all redirect.
api.get() calls have no .catch/error state; a backend failure leaves permanent 'Laster...' text.
Destructive delete (removes duel + all its tips) fires immediately with no confirmation dialog.

issues: Horizontal white->transparent gradient does not cover the right side on narrow screens, so hero paragraph text ('klatre pa lederboardet') sits over the bright photo with weak contrast. Use a vertical/stronger overlay below sm breakpoint.
Inactive tip count/sub-label uses text-slate-400 on white (~2.6:1) - below WCAG AA for small text.

action_items: Validate ObjectId in duel routes (tip/result/delete) and return 400/404 instead of 500
Add login rate limiting / lockout after 5 failed attempts (playbook requirement)
Guard /mine-tips for anonymous users (redirect to /login) and add .catch/error states to page fetches
Optional: confirmation dialog before duel deletion; aggregation for leaderboard
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: every ObjectId(duel_id) call is unguarded -> 500s on any malformed id (also DELETE /api/duels/{id} silently returns ok:true for non-existent ids; consider 404).
set_result point reversal works but is not atomic/transactional; concurrent result updates could double-award points.
seed_admin correctly re-hashes the admin password when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes and bcrypt hash verified as $2b$ format in DB.
DuelCard keeps pick in local state initialized from prop; if parent re-fetches with a different pick (e.g. tip changed elsewhere) the state will not sync (no useEffect on myPick).
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted temporary users (TEST_*@test.no, tester*@test.no) and QA duels; ran cleanup_test_data.py so DB is back to 3 demo duels + admin only, tip_counts recomputed to 0.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -q` for regression; 2 known failures are real product gaps (500 on invalid ObjectId, no brute-force lockout). Use /app/backend/tests/cleanup_test_data.py after runs to purge TEST_/tester users, QA duels and recompute tip_counts. All core UI flows already verified green.
rca_of_the_issue: 500 on tip/result/delete: ObjectId(duel_id) is constructed directly from the path parameter, so bson raises InvalidId before any handler logic, producing an unhandled 500. Reproduce: POST {BASE}/api/duels/not-an-objectid/tip with a valid Bearer token.
